Context

R&E Tours is owned and operated by Rick Klimek. After I rebuilt the R&E Tours website, the next project was a dashboard for the company’s tour record keeping.

Today, Rick keeps tour records in multiple spreadsheets across multiple folders in Google Drive. In one spreadsheet, Rick tracks the itinerary and venues, calculates payments for each student, and records the staff he hires, payments made, and more. Each year he copies the previous year’s spreadsheet, so the old information carries over instead of starting fresh.

Constraints

The dashboard has to fit a small business budget, be easy for Rick to maintain without ongoing help, and feel familiar to someone who already works in spreadsheets every day.

What I learned

With records this complex, I encouraged Rick to work with me one-on-one to customize each screen, so nothing was left out.

Key decisions

Building it with AI, inside Google Drive

I’m the designer, and I’m developing the dashboard with AI, which lets me take it from design to a working tool on my own. I chose Google Apps Script so the dashboard lives in Google Drive, right alongside the spreadsheets Rick already uses.
